description:
Reply to a comment (or add a top-level comment) on a connected account. THIS PUBLISHES A REPLY on the platform.

Supported platforms: facebook, instagram, youtube, linkedin, threads, bluesky, google-business.

Reply target by platform (provide the right one):
- instagram, youtube: commentId (the comment to reply to).
- facebook, linkedin: commentId to reply to a comment, OR postId for a top-level comment. (linkedin commentId must be the composite comment URN; postId is the post URN.)
- threads: commentId or postId (the thread/reply id being responded to).
- bluesky: parentUri + parentCid + rootUri + rootCid — all four are required. Get them from a comment's platformData.replyRefs (returned by list_comments / list_mentions).
- google-business: commentId (the reviewId). google-business comments are customer reviews; platformData.starRating carries the 1-5 rating; replying to an already-replied review overwrites the existing reply (a review has at most one owner reply, max 4096 chars).

accountId.description: Specific connected account id. Omit to use the first connected account for the platform.

commentId.description: Reply to this comment. Used by instagram, youtube, facebook, linkedin, threads.

parentCid.description: bluesky only: CID of the parent (from platformData.replyRefs).

parentUri.description: bluesky only: AT-URI of the post being replied to (from platformData.replyRefs).

platform.description: Engagement platform: facebook, instagram, youtube, linkedin, threads, bluesky, or google-business.

postId.description: Top-level comment on this post (facebook, linkedin) or thread reply target (threads).

rootCid.description: bluesky only: CID of the thread root (from platformData.replyRefs).

rootUri.description: bluesky only: AT-URI of the thread root (from platformData.replyRefs).

name: reply_to_comment
title: Reply to Comment
